channel.title: The WebWell blog
channel.description: Guides on focus, screen time and a calmer browser.

item.title: Free Momentum Alternatives for a Calmer New Tab (2026)
item.description: An honest look at free new-tab extensions like Bonjourr, Tabliss, start.me and WebWell: what each does well, and how to pick one that respects your privacy.

item.title: How to Block YouTube Shorts on Desktop (Chrome and Brave)
item.description: Three ways to hide or block YouTube Shorts in Chrome and Brave on your computer, from YouTube’s own setting to extensions, with what each one really does.

item.title: How to Track Your Screen Time in Chrome Without Giving Away Your History
item.description: Chrome on desktop has no built-in screen time. Here is how website time trackers work, what to check before you trust one, and how to see where your day goes without uploading it.

item.title: Pomodoro Timer in Chrome: How to Set One Up (and Make It Work)
item.description: How to run the Pomodoro technique in Chrome or Brave: what the 25/5 rule really is, three ways to set a timer, and why blocking distractions matters more than the clock.

item.title: What Permissions Do New Tab and Focus Extensions Really Ask For? (Data Study)
item.description: We read the public manifests of seven open-source new tab, focus and blocker extensions. See what each asks for, what is optional, and how to audit any extension.
